map.方差分析(ANOVA)计算器。科学研究工具，采用标准科学公式，计算精准。: Compare the means of three or more groups with one-way ANOVA: between/within sum of squares, the F statistic and a significance hint.
map.单因素方差分析：组间均方与组内均方之比服从 F 分布，df₁ = k−1、df₂: One-way ANOVA: the ratio of between-group mean square to within-group mean square follows an F distribution, with df1 = k-1 and df2 = N-k; a larger F indicates more significant differences among group means (interpret together with the p-value).

map.至少有一组均值不同: At least one group mean differs
map.若 p < 0.05，拒绝 H₀，组间存在显著差异: If p < 0.05, reject H0: a significant difference exists among groups
map.• SSB：组间平方和（组均值与总均值之差）: • SSB: between-group sum of squares (difference between group means and the grand mean)
map.• SSW：组内平方和（组内数据与组均值之差）: • SSW: within-group sum of squares (difference between each value and its group mean)
map.• k：组数；N：总样本数: • k: number of groups; N: total sample size
